target_customer: Indian employers with 100 or more employees that buy group health benefits
problem: Indian group health insurance covers hospital stays but not everyday doctor visits, so employees rarely use it. Loop bundles insurance with unlimited primary care.
business_model: Insurance brokerage commission plus per member primary care fees and referral revenue on prescriptions, labs and hospitalization
product_category: Employer health benefits and primary care

founders.name: Mayank Kale
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Ryan Singh
prior_employers: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (entrepreneurship programs)
education: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Finance and Marketing

technical_complexity.rationale: Core product is insurance brokerage plus clinics and an app. Operational and regulatory work was harder than the software.

defensibility.rationale: An IRDAI direct broker licence and employer relationships with clinic networks create some friction, but insurance products are bought from the same insurers as competitors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying Loop. Loop kept raising through 2022 and reports 1 million lives covered.

market_need_then: Company stated in YC materials that about 200 million Indians have employer funded insurance that covers hospitalization but not doctor visits and that only 8 percent of employees use it in a year. These are company claims, not independent figures.

branding.domain_note: Uses loophealth.com, not the exact loop.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and positive: Healthcare and insurance made easy, Not just for sick days

branding.brand_signature: Not just for sick days tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized with employers and covered by Indian business press, but the name is shared with several other Loop companies and no community or virality evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Loop raised a seed, a 12 million Series A and a 25 million Series B within about 18 months of YC and now claims about 1,250 companies and 950,000 members on its site. It sells to employers through a repeatable channel. Revenue estimated near 8.9 crore rupees in FY24 against a large loss suggests heavy burn, so later funding is unknown.
notes: Totals vary (39.3M or 40M across aggregators). Layoff and liquidation hits were for Loop Insurance, a different US company, and were excluded. Inc42 financial figures are estimates. Founded year 2017 per YC, 2018 per aggregators. No dated competitor sources found near 2020, so the list is empty.
